title: Multilingual blind-spot transfer: are shared failures replicated across languages?

original_idea.body:
# Multilingual blind-spot transfer

Translate safety/factual probes into 3-4 languages; query multilingual open models and measure per-language correlated failure across models and whether the same conceptual items fail across languages. Inference only; no training.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 3: plausible chain (language-invariant shared blind spots are systemic) but catastrophic link is diffuse.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 4: translate probes, query multilingual models, measure cross-language overlap; translation quality control needed.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 4: focused deliverable (language-invariant shared-failure rate); translation adds a dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 5: under-served non-English populations, diffuse long-horizon, labs deprioritize, no internal access.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference + matching on translated prompts, light.

novelty.reasoning: Multilingual safety studied; the cross-language shared-blind-spot homogeneity angle is plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Extends shared-blind-spot framing across languages; plausibly open.
